rows.label: Exact model
rows.value: NanoRFE NanoVNA V2 Plus4 Pro

rows.label: Instrument type
rows.value: Two-port transmission/reflection VNA; S11 and S21 measurements

rows.label: Store frequency range
rows.value: 50 kHz–4 GHz

rows.label: Detailed specification range
rows.value: Maker product table lists 50 kHz–4.4 GHz for Plus4/Plus4 Pro

rows.label: Pro distinction
rows.value: Adjustable IF bandwidth; maker documents crystal measurement on Pro

rows.label: Display and body
rows.value: Touchscreen; store lists 300 g

rows.label: USB power
rows.value: 4.6–5.5 V; maker table lists 500 mA typical without charging

rows.label: Battery reference
rows.value: Table lists 3200 mAh for Plus4/Pro; shipment inclusion requires confirmation

rows.label: Store bundle
rows.value: SOLT calibration kit and two 30 cm SS405 cables

rows.label: Antenna connection
rows.value: SMA measurement port; add the adapter required by the antenna feedline

rows.label: Calibration
rows.value: Calibrate after changing sweep range; use open, short and load at the cable end; thru for transmission

rows.label: Antenna workflow
rows.value: Use CH0/S11 with return-loss and SWR traces; adjust the antenna while observing the sweep

rows.label: Computer workflow
rows.value: USB connection; NanoVNA-QT provides S-parameter export and calibration options

rows.label: Useful shared artifact
rows.value: Maker guide describes exporting measurements and screenshots to document antenna builds

resources.label: Exact maker store model and bundle
Plus4/Plus4 Pro specifications and download links

gaps: Store and detailed specification table disagree on the upper frequency limit. Summary uses the store’s 4 GHz figure; confirm exact hardware/firmware before relying on operation beyond it.
Cell inclusion, exact supplied battery, USB connector/cable bundle and shipment timing were not established for the Pro order.
Accuracy, dynamic range and calibration stability were not independently measured. Do not translate matching impedance into a measured communication-range improvement.
This proposal is for the NanoRFE Plus4 Pro, not all products sold under the NanoVNA name. Current Plus4-family hardware is not established here as openly licensed.
Price remains null. Tax, shipping, stock at checkout and rights to republish product media remain unresolved.

gaps: E1001 is the monochrome model; E1002/E1003/E1004 examples must not be used interchangeably. The catalog does not promise touchscreen operation.
The maker’s long battery-life claim depends on refresh frequency and sleep configuration; no runtime was measured.
The microphone’s presence does not establish a finished voice feature. Follow the selected firmware’s supported functions.
A Home Assistant host and working weather/entity integration are prerequisites for the proposed ESPHome dashboard. They are not included with this display.

gaps: Wi-Fi, alternate lenses, controller boards, USB power/data cables and microSD are not all part of the listed sensor package; select required accessories explicitly.
A learned model’s confidence output is not independently validated accuracy. Lighting, framing and object variation must be tested for each shared build.
Do not assume UNO R4 compatibility from an older UNO example; use the exact documented controller, library and wiring combination.
Model Hub and advanced cloud/LLM feature availability were not verified. The proposal relies on documented local classifier behavior.
